name: Mislav A-Z Navigator
author: mislavkvesic

sections.description:
Mislav A-Z Navigator is a lightweight WordPress plugin that lets you create an alphabetical navigation system where each letter reveals its own set of links or text content. Whether you are building a resource hub, glossary, or curated list of links, this plugin gives you a simple and flexible way to organize everything.

You can add both plain text and links under each letter. Links are automatically recognized and rendered correctly, making it easy to mix different types of content without extra configuration.

The plugin also supports custom alphabets and special characters such as č, ć, š, đ, ž, and more. This makes it useful for multilingual sites or region-specific content. You are not limited to the default A-Z structure.

You can reorder letters to match your preferred structure or language. The frontend output includes clear CSS classes that can be styled from your theme, the Customizer, or the Site Editor.

Features

  • A-Z or custom alphabetical navigation
  • Add both links and plain text per letter
  • Automatic link detection and rendering
  • Support for special characters such as č, ć, š, đ, ž, and more
  • Reorder letters to match your needs
  • Disabled letters when empty for a cleaner user experience
  • Simple admin interface
  • Frontend CSS classes for theme-level styling
  • Lightweight and fast
  • Works with any WordPress theme

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/mislav-az-navigator/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings > Mislav A-Z Navigator.
  4. Add your content for each letter.
  5. Place the shortcode [mislav_az_navigator] on any page or post.
sections.faq:
Can I add links?

Yes. Plain URLs are linked automatically. You can also use the format Label|https://example.com.

Can I use custom letters?

Yes. You can add custom letters and special characters from the admin screen.

How can I style the navigator?

Use your theme, Customizer, or Site Editor to add CSS for the frontend classes. The admin screen lists the available selectors, including .az-navigator-wrapper, .az-navigator-letters, .az-navigator-letter, .az-navigator-content, .az-navigator-list, and .az-navigator-link.
